title: Personal Checking: Monthly Maintenance Fee and Activity-Based Waiver Levels
content:
## What this card fixes

For each Personal Checking tier, the card gives the monthly maintenance fee charged once per statement cycle at cycle close and the level each balance- or activity-based waiver must reach. A waiver shown as "not offered" does not exist on that tier.

- **Monthly maintenance fee (USD)** — the charge for one statement cycle when no waiver is met.
- **Lowest daily balance (USD)** — the waiver is met when the smallest end-of-day ledger balance across the cycle is at or above this level.
- **Direct deposits (USD)** — the waiver is met when ACH direct deposits posted during the cycle total at least this much.
- **Relationship balance (USD)** — the waiver is met when the relationship balance at cycle close is at or above this level.
- **Debit card purchases (count)** — the waiver is met when at least this many debit card purchases posted in the cycle.
- **Mortgage principal counts** — whether outstanding PCB mortgage principal is added into this tier's relationship balance.

## Tier table

| Tier | Fee | Lowest daily balance | Direct deposits | Relationship balance | Debit card purchases | Mortgage principal counts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 5.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | no |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | no |
| Everyday Checking | 12.00 | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 5000.00 | 10 | no |
| Interest Checking | 15.00 | 5000.00 | not offered | 15000.00 | not offered | no |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 | 10000.00 | not offered | 25000.00 | not offered | yes |
| Private Client Checking | 35.00 | not offered | not offered | 250000.00 | not offered | yes |

## Points of judgement

- Everyday Checking is the only tier offering all four balance- and activity-based waivers.
- Only Premier Checking and Private Client Checking add mortgage principal into the relationship balance.
- Student Checking carries a fee of 0.00, so no maintenance charge arises on it whatever its activity.
- Hypothetical example: an Everyday Checking account with nine debit card purchases in a cycle is one short of its purchase level of 10; with ten it meets that waiver.
